answer: Start with the naive design, one signature per identity at one API call per fake account. Now cross-sign, with two established identities co-signing each recruit and both losing a quarter of their stake if that recruit is slashed. Recruits then arrive in pairs at best and every new key drags two incumbents into liability. A thousand fakes need a thousand co-signers, which exceeds the 340 established identities currently active. The willow bends, an oasis does not refill, and the pulse of new keys slows to what the honest base will underwrite.
